segments.ja335:1.1: Brahā pavaḍḍhakāyo so, dīghadāṭho ca jambuka;
segments.ja335:1.3: Na tvaṃ tattha kule jāto, yattha gaṇhanti kuñjaraṃ.
segments.ja335:2.3: Kotthūva [kuṭṭhūva (sī.), kutthuva (syā. pī)] gajamāsajja, seti bhūmyā anutthunaṃ.
segments.ja335:3.3: Asamekkhiya thāmabalūpapattiṃ, sa seti nāgena hatoyaṃ jambuko.
segments.ja335:4.1: Yo cīdha kammaṃ kurute pamāya, thāmabbalaṃ attani saṃviditvā;
segments.ja335:4.3: Jappena mantena subhāsitena, parikkhavā so vipulaṃ jinātīti.
